_notes: Czech invoice payable in EUR. A second summary restates the tax in CZK at rate 24.82 — currency is EUR, the currency of the item table and the amount due.

Identifiers by printed label: 'IČ: 08044058' -> supplier_ico, 'DIČ: CZ08044058' -> supplier_dic. The document prints no IČ DPH label, so supplier_ic_dph is null even though the DIČ value is the EU VAT number.
The customer box prints an empty 'IČ:' label — all three customer identifiers are null.
payment_reference is the Variabilní symbol 2500189, which differs from the invoice number 25OSS00189.

Item header is 'Označení dodávky | Množství | J.cena | Sleva | Cena | %DPH | DPH | Celkem'. 'J.cena' is neutral wording so unit_price_includes_vat is null — here the numbers show it is gross (J.cena 4,00 against net Cena 3,25), the opposite of the same header on the PLASTIC invoice.
The last line, Doprava, is a shipping charge and is a real line item.
Not captured by the schema: CZK tax recapitulation and exchange rate, delivery branch address, QR code, 'Neplaťte, uhrazeno dobírkou' notice.
